distribution: ceil(nominal*common_percent*local_percent/10000), clipped to reviewed bounds; whole shared phase uses max member local percent
protected: HEAT and all fixed-process phases, including mandatory intervention stages; zero absorbed preheat remains zero
trigger: first visible estimated phase in initial plan completes at least 30 seconds later than planned
cache: complete observed session + pinned knowledge + policy; no seed, private factor or future duration
limitations: Synthetic weights are sensitivity assumptions, not measurements or empirical P90
At most one observed trigger per trajectory is a fixed experimental control
Pure execution/material transitions and planning core; SQL publication and HTTP budgets are separate P6-05/P6-06 evidence
All failed and incomplete trajectories remain in the full denominators
BUFFERED remains optional; no duration inflation or resource reservation for free waiting
